title: Migrate Papyrus + Threat Intelligence content to Markus Markdown bodies

comments.author: home
comments.text:
GOAL: migrate ALL existing content to Markus Markdown bodies. Maximalist - decided explicitly by Ryan: do not avoid big changes for expediency, fix existing Papyrus and Threat Intelligence content now.

SCOPE:
1. Convert every existing article from body: string[] + pullQuotes: string[] to a single Markus Markdown body, with pull quotes placed POSITIONALLY as :::pull-quote directives where they belong in the prose (not appended at the end - use editorial judgment about where each quote actually pulls from).
2. Sources include lib/articles.ts seed articles, publications/threat_intelligence/seed/seed-edition-content.json, and any GraphQL seed/scenario fixtures. Find them all - grep, do not assume this list is complete.
3. Write a repeatable migration script; do not hand-edit. The script is the deliverable as much as the output.
4. REGRESSION PROOF: use the round-trip from PPY-a10206. Every migrated article must project back to the same paragraph array it has today. Any diff is either a bug or a deliberate improvement you must call out explicitly.
5. Every migrated file must pass 'markus validate'.

DEPENDS ON: PPY-a10206.
